state.paragraph: Following the execution of a confidentiality agreement, on December 9, 2014, J.P. Morgan arranged introductory meetings between Longview and the Buyer Group, and between Longview and Bidder 2. These meetings, which were attended by representatives of J.P. Morgan and Wachtell Lipton, were introductory in nature, to enable the bidders to determine their interest in working with Longview, and vice versa, and the bidders were prohibited at this time from disclosing to Longview the respective prices that the bidders intended to bid.

ledger_rows.Note: Initially set 12/05/2014 for final bids, targeting completion by 12/15/2014.
Moved final-bid deadline from 12/05 to the evening of 12/10 and requested agreement markups and financing commitments in advance if possible.
Final-bid deadline reached; the target received two written final bids and Bidder 3’s verbal indication.
Final cash bid with revised transaction documents; committed financing had been provided on 12/06; documentation was less conditional than Bidder 2’s.
Final cash bid with a revised merger agreement; its documentation was comparatively more conditional than Buyer Group’s.
Verbal whole-company indication; ceiling was approximately the current stock price, not a written final offer.
J.P. Morgan said the valuation was unlikely to compete; Bidder 3 then did not submit the requested written offer. Attribution is flagged.
Required the two remaining bidders to improve by 12/12; treated as an extension within the already announced final round.
Approved Buyer Group’s request to work with Longview; they formed a rollover-support relationship but not a separate bidding group.
Improved-bid deadline; Bidder 2 and Buyer Group submitted revised bids that evening.
Submitted revised agreements and financing commitments; later confirmed $81.50 was best and final.
Oral revision; said it was working to increase the offer within hours. Revised agreements and financing commitments accompanied the final sequence.
Best and final cash offer; revised documents were, with few exceptions, substantially executable and financing commitments were supplied.

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

contact.instructions: `paragraph` reports that the target or its banker contacts potential buyers, or a potential buyer approaches the target, including counts of parties contacted. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
